interest: Shows Japan's 1939 sociology scholarship offer to Uruguay, part of its Latin American cultural outreach.
overview: Despatch (1939): Uruguay's president created a jury to select a professor for a Japanese sociology scholarship in Tokyo.

subfiles.about: Consular despatch reporting on an executive decree establishing a jury to select a Uruguayan professor for a scholarship at the Tokyo Institute of Students.
subfiles.summary: Ferrin reports Uruguay appointed a jury of educators to select a professor for a Japanese sociology scholarship at the Tokyo Institute of Students.
subfiles.title: Despatch from Augustin W. Ferrin on Japanese Scholarship for Uruguayan Professor
